def parse_grid_after(s, marker, h, w):
 pos=s.index(marker)+len(marker)
 chunk=s[pos:].lstrip('\n')
 lines=chunk.splitlines()[:h]
 grid=[]
 for line in lines:
  vals=[int(t) for t in line.strip().split()]
  if len(vals)!=w: raise ValueError((len(vals),w,line))
  grid.append(vals)
 return grid

  a=parse_grid_after(s,m.group(0),h,w)
  om=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} output \({h}x{w}\):',s)
